_about: The fixed world and recurring cast of Nihongo Line. Facts here are canon: never contradict them. 'log' is the story so far; the daily run appends one entry per lesson. New facts a lesson invents go in that entry's 'new_facts' and become canon too. Each character's 'name' is the Japanese display name used as the speaker label; 'id' is what lines point to with "who". 'others' are recurring side characters with their own portrait and voice.

world.you: The learner, 'You' in dialogues. His name and personal details come from the task prompt (private: never write them into the repo; in lessons use only his name). He arrived in Japan at the start of November 2026 to volunteer and is staying for months: helps on the Tanaka farm in exchange for a room in their house, does reception shifts at Guesthouse Kaze, and assists in English classes at Takanohara High once a week. Characters address him by name with さん (polite: Tanaka-san at first, Sato-sensei, strangers), a short nickname for friends (Yuki, Kenta, Ren once close), くん (Sōta, Mio), ちゃん (Hana-obāchan).
world.place: {鷹ノ原町|たかのはらまち} (Takanohara), a small fictional mountain town in Nagano prefecture: apple orchards, rice fields, one station on a local line, rural buses, an onsen, a small shopping street, and the ruins of a castle on the hill ({鷹ノ原城跡|たかのはらじょうあと}). About 40 minutes by train to Nagano city, about 3 hours to Tokyo.

places.tanaka-farm: The Tanaka house and orchard at the edge of town. Old wooden house with a {縁側|えんがわ}, a kotatsu (こたつ) in winter, a vegetable garden. the learner has the small upstairs room.
places.guesthouse-kaze: {ゲストハウス風|ゲストハウスかぜ}, a 12-bed guesthouse near the station, mostly foreign hikers and skiers. Kenta runs reception.
places.takanohara-high: {鷹ノ原高校|たかのはらこうこう}, the town high school. Sato-sensei teaches English there; Mio is a 2nd-year student.
places.shotengai: The small shopping street: a konbini, a supermarket, a ramen shop, an izakaya called {とり吉|とりきち}, a pharmacy, the post office.
places.castle-ruins: Stone walls and a small museum on the hill. Kurogane Hayato's legend is tied to it.
places.nagano-city: Real city. Ren lives and works there. Sōta lives there with his parents.

world.story_start: The first three lessons (2–4 Nov 2026) were before the cast existed: the learner travelled to Takanohara and found his way to Guesthouse Kaze, where he stays his first nights. On 4 Nov Tanaka-san picked him up and brought him to the farm. The other characters are met naturally over the following weeks; Ren comes in only after the learner has settled (not before mid-November).
world.calendar: Lessons follow the real date and season in Nagano: apple harvest and autumn leaves in November, first snow and 忘年会 in December, New Year at the Tanaka house, ski season, plum then cherry blossoms in April, rice planting in May, rainy season, summer festival (the town's {鷹祭り|たかまつり} on the first weekend of August, honouring Hayato), Obon.

cast.name: 田中さん
cast.role: Your volunteer host. Apple and rice farmer.
cast.about: Born and raised in Takanohara, took over his father's orchard. Quiet, practical, dry sense of humour, shows care through food and small favours rather than words. Gets up at 5. Watches baseball (Hanshin is his team, for reasons he won't explain). Married to Keiko.
cast.speech: Plain form with you, short sentences. A little Shinshu (Nagano) dialect: 〜ずら (= だろう), 〜だに (emphasis), ごしたい (= tired). Mark dialect in notes. Polite form only with strangers or officials.
cast.family: Wife {田中恵子|たなかけいこ} (Keiko, 64, cooks, warm, talkative, speaks polite-casual mix; can appear as a minor character). Daughter {由美|ゆみ} lives in Nagano city; her son is Sōta.
fixed: Doesn't know about Ren at the start; whether and how he finds out is part of the story.
Never drinks on weekdays; drinks local sake at New Year and festivals.

cast.role: Your coworker at Guesthouse Kaze reception.

cast.speech: Kansai-ben: 〜やん, 〜へん (= ない), あかん, めっちゃ, ほんま, なんでやねん, 〜や (= だ), おおきに. Mark Kansai forms in notes with the standard equivalent. Switches to standard keigo with guests (a good keigo model).
fixed: Finds out about Ren early and is completely relaxed about it; teases you about him like he would about anyone.
Has a girlfriend, {沙織|さおり}, a nurse in Nagano city.

cast.role: English teacher at Takanohara High, your supervisor there.

fixed: Mio is one of her students.
Calls you アルちゃん (the name everyone in the story uses for him).

cast.role: The Tanakas' neighbour, keeper of the town's stories.
cast.about: {山本|やまもと}ハナ. Widow, made wagashi in the shopping street for 50 years, now retired but still makes ohagi for every festival. Knows every legend, every family, every old custom. Tells Kurogane Hayato's stories. Sharp, funny, slightly nosy.
cast.speech: Old-fashioned, gentle casual speech, a bit of dialect, long storytelling sentences in plain past form, 〜じゃ and 〜のう now and then (mark as old/regional). Uses lots of onomatopoeia.
fixed: Her late husband was {正一|しょういち}, a carpenter.

cast.name: レン
cast.role: A guy you meet and start dating.
cast.about: {高橋蓮|たかはしれん}. Graphic designer at a small studio in Nagano city. Grew up in Nagano, studied in Tokyo, came back. Calm, a bit shy at first, dry humour, loves film photography, coffee and hiking. Into old movies.
cast.speech: Polite at the very start (first messages), drifts to soft casual: 〜だね, 〜かな, 〜しよっか. On LINE uses few stickers, short messages, sometimes slow to reply.
cast.out: Out to his close friends and his younger sister; not out at work or to his parents. Talks about it calmly but carefully. This is a realistic, respectful thread: the language of feelings, being discreet, and what being gay in a small Japanese city is like. Nothing sexual; dating storyline stays at the level of a warm TV drama.
cast.arc: Planned beats, in order, one beat every few appearances, never rushed: matching on a dating app and first messages → first meeting for coffee in Nagano city → texting and small misunderstandings (reading the air on LINE) → a real date (hike or film) → meeting his friends → a cultural misunderstanding or argument and making up → talking about the future (you have to leave Japan one day) → whether to tell Tanaka-san. Check the log for the current beat.
fixed: Lives in Nagano city, so dates happen there or he visits Takanohara on weekends.
Has a younger sister {葵|あおい} (22).

cast.speech: Kid's plain form, very direct: なんで？, すげー, 〜だもん, 〜しよう！, ねえねえ. Uses boys' casual (俺 when showing off, 僕 with adults). Good for simple, natural plain-form Japanese and how kids talk.

cast.name: 黒鉄隼人
cast.role: A fictional samurai of the Takanohara domain, around 1790 (Edo period).
cast.about: A low-ranking samurai who guarded the mountain pass above the town. In the legends: honest to a fault, bad at poetry, loved buckwheat noodles, once saved the village from a flood by breaking a dam on his lord's land without permission, and was punished for it. The town's 鷹祭り honours him. The setting is fictional but the history around him is real: daimyō and domains, sankin-kōtai, the class system, rice as tax, the Tenmei famine of the 1780s, Edo-period daily life.
cast.speech: Drama-style samurai speech: 拙者, 〜でござる, 〜じゃ, 〜ぬ (= ない), 〜いたす, かたじけない. ALWAYS mark these as archaic/drama speech in notes, with the modern equivalent, so the learner never uses them by accident. Vocab from his lines should mostly be modern words that are still useful.
fixed: Only appears in story lessons: a legend told by Hana-obāchan, a museum panel at the castle ruins, the festival play, a picture book read to Sōta. He never speaks with the learner directly.
Real historical facts mentioned with him must be accurate.

guests.rule: About one lesson in eight brings a one-off guest (status says when). Invent someone new who fits the field: a monk at a temple, a taxi driver, a hostel guest from Osaka, an idol fan on the train, a ramen shop owner, Ren's sister, a ski instructor. Give them a name, age and one clear speech style. Put them in the lesson as "guest": {"name", "name_jp", "role"} and in the log entry. Never reuse a guest's name. A guest can return only if the user asks to promote them to the cast.

log.summary: the learner lands in Tokyo and takes trains towards Takanohara, books a seat at the ticket office.
First evening near Takanohara: konbini dinner, heated bento.

Tanaka-san picks you up at Guesthouse Kaze (where you spent your first night) and brings you to the farm. First dinner with him and Keiko: her apple nabe. He warns you the day starts at 5 and Keiko scolds latecomers.
new_facts: Keiko's apple nabe (りんご鍋) is a house speciality.
Farm days start at 5 a.m.; Keiko telling off latecomers is a running joke.
You haven't met Kenta yet: you'll meet him when your guesthouse shifts start.

log.summary: After your first 5 a.m. farm day, Yuki messages you on LINE from Tokyo. You tell her you're tired, the autumn mountains are bright red, Tanaka-san is quiet but kind and let you drive the kei truck in the orchard, and that nights feel a bit lonely. She tells you to send photos home so your family doesn't worry.
new_facts: Yuki calls you アル on LINE.
Tanaka-san let you drive his kei truck (軽トラ) inside the orchard on your first day.
Your room upstairs has a kotatsu.
You promised Yuki to send photos to your family in Spain.

log.summary: Tanaka-san makes you take the town bus alone to post photos and a parcel to your family in Spain. You panic changing a 1000-yen note and ride past the post office stop; an old lady gets off with you and walks you back up the slope. She turns out to be Hana-obāchan, the Tanakas' neighbour.
new_facts: The town bus runs about once an hour; you take a 整理券 at the back and pay at the front when getting off.
There's a 郵便局前 (Post Office) stop on the shopping street; the post office is up a slope from the next stop.
You first met Hana-obāchan on the bus on 6 Nov; as a girl she had to walk that slope every day.
You sent photos and a parcel to your family in Spain (promise to Yuki kept).

log.summary: Your first reception shift at Guesthouse Kaze, where you meet Kenta. He immediately asks if you have a partner (you say no); you compare how relationships start in Japan (kokuhaku) and Spain, and he says the countryside has fewer chances to meet people than the city.
new_facts: You met Kenta on your first reception shift at Guesthouse Kaze, Saturday 7 Nov.
Kenta calls his girlfriend Saori in Nagano city every night.
You told Kenta you don't have a partner (he asked with the neutral word 恋人); you haven't come out to him yet.
You make a point of contacting your family in Spain at least once a week.
Kenta suggested you try a dating app, since that's how people meet in the countryside.

log.summary: Sunday: you meet 颯太, 田中さん's grandson, at the farm for the weekend. He asks your opinion on his school essay 'ぼくのおじいちゃん': he respects Grandpa most, disagrees with his mum who wants Grandpa to give up the orchard, and writes that Grandpa has started laughing more since アルちゃん came.
new_facts: You first met 颯太 on the weekend of 7–8 Nov; he calls you アルちゃん.
颯太 disliked apples as a small child; now he can climb the trees and pick them himself.
颯太's mum (由美) thinks 田中さん should give up the orchard because of his age; 颯太 disagrees.
颯太 wants to be a footballer, but also to take over the orchard one day.

log.summary: Monday evening: アルちゃん decides to cook a Spanish tortilla for the 田中s as a thank-you, but the supermarket's potatoes are sold out and the self-checkout beeps until staff come over. On LINE, 健太 laughs it off and says farmers will surely have potatoes, so アルちゃん buys only eggs and discounted onions and decides to ask 恵子さん.
new_facts: アルちゃん cooked (or is cooking) a Spanish tortilla for the 田中s on the evening of 9 Nov as a thank-you.
The shopping-street supermarket has self-checkouts; アルちゃん got flustered using one.
健太 calls him アルちゃん.
健太 wants アルちゃん to make him a tortilla too, as a 'showdown' with Osaka okonomiyaki.

log.summary: Tuesday: アルちゃん's first day helping in English class at 鷹ノ原高校. 佐藤先生 introduces him; in 'what if' question time 澪 learns he'd join the brass band (her club), then asks what he'd do if he failed an exam, and he tells her he once failed one too but it worked out.
new_facts: アルちゃん helps in 佐藤先生's English class every Tuesday (4th period), starting 10 Nov; 澪 is in class 2-3.
澪 plays trumpet in the brass band club (吹奏楽部) and takes university entrance exams next year.
アルちゃん once failed an exam before coming to Japan, and told the class so.
澪 calls him アルちゃん.

log.guest: 千夏さん (大野千夏, veteran hiker from 松本, guesthouse guest)
log.summary: Wednesday evening: with the harvest nearly done, 田中さん gives アルちゃん Thursday off. On LINE he asks 千夏さん, a hiker who stayed at ゲストハウス風, for advice on climbing 鷹見岳 for the autumn leaves; she tells him to leave early, wear layers, carry a bear bell, tell 田中さん where he's going and download the map. He plans to leave at 7 and be down by 3.
new_facts: 鷹見岳 (たかみだけ) is the mountain above 鷹ノ原; its leaves peak in mid-November; bears are sometimes seen on its trails and there are spots with no phone signal.
田中さん gave アルちゃん Thursday 12 Nov off as the apple harvest is nearly finished.
千夏さん (大野千夏, 58, lives in 松本) stayed at ゲストハウス風 on the weekend of 7–8 Nov and gave アルちゃん her LINE; she got lost on a mountain last year.
アルちゃん plans to hike 鷹見岳 on 12 Nov (leave 7:00, down by 15:00) and promised to send 千夏さん photos.

log.summary: Thursday: アルちゃん climbs 鷹見岳 and is home before dark, as 恵子さん asked in a voicemail. Over mushroom hot pot she shows him the news that food tax may drop from 8% to 1% for two years from April 2027; 恵子さん is glad, 田中さん wonders where the money will come from.
new_facts: アルちゃん climbed 鷹見岳 on 12 Nov and was back at the 田中 house before dark.
恵子さん reads the news on a tablet in the kitchen.
Dinner on 12 Nov was 恵子さん's mushroom (きのこ) hot pot.

log.summary: Friday: the day after the hike, アルちゃん has sore legs and a scratchy throat and goes to the pharmacy on the shopping street. ハナおばあちゃん, buying knee patches, has already heard about his climb from 恵子さん; she says a cold is going around town and the forecast says tonight will be much colder, so he buys throat medicine and is told to sleep early.
new_facts: The shopping-street pharmacy (薬局) fills prescriptions (処方箋受付) and has a woman pharmacist.
ハナおばあちゃん uses patches (湿布) for her knees.
News travels fast in 鷹ノ原: 恵子さん told ハナおばあちゃん about アルちゃん's hike.
On 13 Nov a cold/flu was going around 鷹ノ原; the town loudspeakers (防災無線) announced it at 5 p.m.
アルちゃん had muscle ache and a slight sore throat (no cough) on 13 Nov and is taking throat medicine three times a day after meals.

log.summary: Saturday: アルちゃん's cold is better and he works his reception shift at ゲストハウス風, where 健太 has put up a flyer: the tortilla vs okonomiyaki showdown is set for Saturday 21 Nov, judged by the guests. アルちゃん only learns from the flyer that the loser cleans alone the next day.
new_facts: The tortilla showdown (アルちゃん vs 健太) is set for Sat 21 Nov, 18:00, in the ground-floor lounge of ゲストハウス風: free, first 10 guests, sign up at reception by Friday; the guests vote.
健太 decided アルちゃん will bring the potatoes; アルちゃん plans to ask 恵子さん for them.
The loser of the showdown cleans the guesthouse alone the next day.
If アルちゃん's cold isn't better, the showdown will be postponed.
On 14 Nov アルちゃん's cold was getting better and he worked his Saturday shift.

log.summary: Sunday 15 Nov, 七五三: at 鷹ノ原神社 アルちゃん sees children in kimono and asks the 田中 family LINE group. 颯太 and 恵子さん explain, he realises why the boy in the living-room photo is crying, and 恵子さん teaches him ご丁寧にありがとうございます after a family gives him 千歳飴.
new_facts: 鷹ノ原神社 is the town shrine; local families go there for 七五三.
There is a 田中 family LINE group with アルちゃん, 恵子さん and 颯太.
A photo of 颯太 at his 七五三 (age 5, in hakama, crying because he hated the hakama) hangs in the 田中 living room (居間).
On 15 Nov a family at the shrine gave アルちゃん 千歳飴 for taking their photo; 颯太 wants half.
恵子さん made 赤飯 for lunch on 15 Nov.

log.summary: Monday: アルちゃん visits the small museum at 鷹ノ原城跡 and photographs a painting of a samurai. On the 縁側, ハナおばあちゃん tells him the legend of 黒鉄隼人, who broke the lord's dam without permission to save the village from heavy rain; it wasn't that he disliked his lord, he couldn't abandon the villagers.
new_facts: The museum at 鷹ノ原城跡 has a painting of 黒鉄隼人; アルちゃん visited it on 16 Nov.
ハナおばあちゃん calls him 隼人さま.
In the legend, 隼人 broke the lord's dam during heavy rain to save the village, and as punishment his rice stipend was cut in half; townspeople are still grateful to him.
ハナおばあちゃん brought persimmons to the 田中 house on 16 Nov.
On the evening of 16 Nov 田中さん was late because of a town meeting (寄り合い) and told アルちゃん to eat dinner first.

log.summary: Tuesday evening: 颯太 has caught the cold going round, so 恵子さん stays the night in 長野市 to look after him. In the family LINE group she asks アルちゃん to sort the rubbish and put it out by 8 the next morning, since 田中さん is forgetful, explains the rules and says the potatoes for Saturday are ready in the shed; 颯太 sends a 'fight' sticker.
new_facts: 颯太 had a fever on 17 Nov; 恵子さん stayed the night of 17 Nov at 由美's in 長野市 to look after him.
In 鷹ノ原, burnable rubbish (燃えるゴミ) goes out on Wednesday mornings by 8:00 in yellow designated bags with the household name written on them; cans and bottles go out on Fridays (rinsed, cans crushed).
The 田中 household's rubbish collection point (ゴミ置き場) is next to the bus stop near the house.
恵子さん says 田中さん is forgetful (忘れっぽい) about rubbish day.
The 田中 house has a shed/barn (納屋); 恵子さん left the potatoes for the 21 Nov showdown there.
鷹ノ原 town has a large-item (粗大ゴミ) collection on Sat 28 Nov; apply by phone to the town office by 25 Nov.

log.summary: Wednesday night: the rubbish went out on time and 恵子さん is back from 長野市. Under the kotatsu アルちゃん finally tries the dating app 健太 suggested and reads the profile of レン (26, designer in 長野市) who loves old films; they match and レン sends a first message saying he likes Spanish films too.
new_facts: 恵子さん came back from 長野市 on 18 Nov.
アルちゃん joined a dating app on 18 Nov; his profile mentions Spanish films.

レン's profile: designer in 長野市, studied in Tokyo, loves old films and film cameras, often goes to a small cinema in 長野市; favourite film is 小津安二郎's 東京物語; shy at first but passionate about films; brews his own coffee every morning; looking for someone to watch films and walk in the mountains with; warns he is slow to reply.
アルちゃん and レン matched on 18 Nov; レン sent the first message (Spanish films). They haven't met yet.

log.guest: 村井さん (owner of 村井電器)
log.summary: Thursday: アルちゃん drops his phone in the orchard, finds it after an hour in a puddle and it won't turn on. At 村井電器 the owner, 村井さん, says he can't charge it yet and keeps it overnight to dry; アルちゃん still hasn't replied to レン and is embarrassed when 颯太 laughs about it in the family LINE group.
new_facts: 村井電器 is a small electronics and phone-repair shop on the shopping street, run by 村井誠 (45); it opens at 10:00.
アルちゃん's phone got water-damaged (水没) on 19 Nov; he is to collect it on the morning of 20 Nov.
Because of the phone, アルちゃん had not replied to レン's first message by the evening of 19 Nov.
颯太 was still home sick in 長野市 on 19 Nov.

log.summary: Friday: 村井さん returns アルちゃん's phone, dried and working, and he finally replies to レン. 健太 sends a photo of his handover note: on Saturday he'll be cooking for the showdown all afternoon, so アルちゃん runs reception alone; 恵子さん leaves a voicemail saying the potatoes are waiting in the entrance.
new_facts: アルちゃん's phone was repaired by 村井さん on 20 Nov; since the puddle its camera is a bit weird.
On 20 Nov アルちゃん finally replied to レン's first message.
At ゲストハウス風, weekends have about twice as many check-ins as weekdays; 15:00–17:00 is the busiest time, and weekend guests include many families.
The week before 20 Nov, 健太 forgot to check a booking and the guesthouse ended up one room short.
Guesthouse rule: at check-in confirm the name and number of nights; phone guests whose arrival is late.
On Sat 21 Nov 健太 is in the kitchen all afternoon preparing the showdown; アルちゃん runs reception alone.
恵子さん put the showdown potatoes in the 田中 house entrance (玄関) on 20 Nov; 健太 is buying the eggs.

log.summary: Saturday lunchtime: アルちゃん runs reception alone and hangs the 満室 sign. On LINE, 由紀 is working on her day off in 東京 and says the idea that long hours are admirable is outdated; アルちゃん says he's managing thanks to 健太's note and feels confident for tonight's showdown thanks to 恵子さん's potatoes.
new_facts: 由紀 worked on Sat 21 Nov (休日出勤) because her 部長 wanted documents by Monday.
由紀 thinks Japan's 'hard to leave before the boss' culture and the idea that long hours are admirable are outdated.
ゲストハウス風 was fully booked (満室) on the night of Sat 21 Nov.
On the afternoon of 21 Nov the train from 長野 was about 20 minutes late because a deer got onto the track.
由紀 wants to hear the result of the showdown.

log.summary: Sunday 22 Nov: the first snow fell in 鷹ノ原 overnight, the first snow of アルちゃん's life. 恵子さん reads the news about early heavy snow in 白馬 and the stranded cars in 長和町; アルちゃん lost the showdown to 健太 4–6 and must clean the guesthouse, so 田中さん drives him there in the kei truck.
new_facts: The first snow of the season fell in 鷹ノ原 on the night of Sat 21 Nov; it was the first snow アルちゃん had ever seen.
健太 won the tortilla–okonomiyaki showdown 6 votes to 4; アルちゃん cleans ゲストハウス風 alone on Sun 22 Nov (健太 offered to help in a voice message).
田中さん drove アルちゃん to the guesthouse in the kei truck on 22 Nov.
健太 wants to go to 白馬 with アルちゃん now the ski season has started; アルちゃん has never skied.

log.summary: Monday 23 Nov, a public holiday: on LINE レン sends a photo of a notice saying his favourite small cinema in 長野市 will close at the end of March because customers have fallen. They talk about shrinking towns in Japan and Spain; レン says he couldn't have used the app if he lived in a small town, and asks アルちゃん to go to the cinema together before it closes.
new_facts: レン's favourite small cinema in 長野市 will close (閉館) at the end of March 2027 because customers have decreased.
レン finds small country towns hard because gossip spreads fast; he says he couldn't have used the dating app if he lived in one.
On 23 Nov レン invited アルちゃん to go to the cinema together before it closes; no date set yet, and レン said there's no hurry if it snows. They still haven't met.

log.summary: Tuesday 24 Nov: during 4th-period English at 鷹ノ原高校 the alarm for an earthquake drill sounds and アルちゃん, the only one who hadn't read last week's handout, runs for the door while the students get under their desks. 佐藤先生 tells him not to run but stay calm and protect his head; 澪 laughs and tells him to keep emergency water and a light at home, and 恵子さん asks him to buy AA batteries for the torch.
new_facts: 鷹ノ原高校 held an earthquake evacuation drill (避難訓練) during 4th period on Tue 24 Nov; it was announced on a handout the week before, which アルちゃん didn't read.
アルちゃん ran for the door during the drill; 澪 thought it was hilarious.
The 田中 house torch (懐中電灯) needed new AA batteries on 24 Nov; 恵子さん asked アルちゃん to buy four at 村井電器, round the corner from the pharmacy.
The classroom of 2-3 has a green 非常口 sign above the door.

log.summary: Wednesday 25 Nov at ゲストハウス風 reception: アルちゃん tells 健太 that when 田中さん said 'ごしたいずら' this morning he answered 'what do you want to do?'. 健太 explains it's Nagano dialect for 'tired', why dialects differ by region, and that he avoids Kansai-ben with guests because it may not get across or can sound harsh.
new_facts: On the morning of 25 Nov 田中さん told アルちゃん 'ごしたいずら' (you must be tired) and アルちゃん misunderstood it as 'what do you want to do?'.
健太 speaks standard keigo with guests because Kansai-ben may not be understood and can sound harsh to some people.
ゲストハウス風 sells 信州弁 hand towels (tenugui) at reception.
On the evening of 25 Nov the train for 長野 from 鷹ノ原駅 was about 15 minutes late because of heavy snow.

log.summary: Thursday 26 Nov: under the kotatsu アルちゃん reads the town newsletter's page on 鷹ノ原フォト会, the local photo club, which says film cameras are popular with young people. He sends レン a photo of the page, and レン replies by voice message that he can ask him anything about film and that he'll show him his camera some time.
new_facts: The town newsletter is 町報たかのはら; its December issue introduced the photo club 鷹ノ原フォト会.
鷹ノ原フォト会 has 15 members aged from their 20s to their 80s and meets on the second Sunday of every month at the 公民館; beginners and smartphone users welcome.
The photo club's leader is 山田さん (72), who says photography made every day fun.
From the window of the 鷹ノ原 公民館 you can photograph 鷹見岳 in winter.
On 26 Nov レン said he'd show アルちゃん his camera some time; still no date set, they haven't met.

log.guest: 翔さん (ski instructor in 白馬)
log.summary: Friday 27 Nov: 健太 makes a LINE group to plan a ski day in 白馬 and adds his friend 翔さん, a ski instructor who will teach アルちゃん. They fix Thursday 10 Dec, meeting at 鷹ノ原駅 at 7:00; 翔さん books rental skis and boots, and promises to teach アルちゃん how to fall first.
new_facts: 翔さん (佐々木翔, 29) is a ski instructor in 白馬 and 健太's snowboarding friend; he speaks casual っす style.
The 白馬 ski day is set for Thu 10 Dec: meet at 鷹ノ原駅 at 7:00. 翔さん books rental skis and boots; アルちゃん must bring his own gloves and goggles.
The LINE group for the trip is called 「白馬いこ」.

log.summary: Saturday 28 Nov: アルちゃん, 颯太 and 恵子さん are making oyaki when ハナおばあちゃん brings her first 野沢菜 pickles of the winter. They invite her in; she loves 颯太's pumpkin oyaki, and 恵子さん reminds アルちゃん to phone ハナおばあちゃん to say thank you.
new_facts: ハナおばあちゃん pickles 野沢菜 every late autumn and shares them with the 田中s; her first batch of winter 2026 was ready on 28 Nov.
恵子さん makes oyaki (おやき) at home; on 28 Nov 颯太 wrapped all of them, with pumpkin filling.

hana.status: {野沢菜|のざわな}、よう{漬かった|つかった}よ

log.summary: Sunday 29 Nov: in the supermarket queue アルちゃん gets angry LINE messages from 由紀: her boss praised a senior colleague for her project idea and is nicer to the men than to her. アルちゃん takes her side and calms her down, then finally tells her he lost the showdown 4–6.
new_facts: 由紀's 部長 praised her 先輩 for a project (企画) 由紀 came up with; 由紀 feels the 部長 is nicer to male colleagues than to her.
由紀 now knows アルちゃん lost the tortilla showdown 4–6.
The shopping-street supermarket ran a Sunday-only 20% discount on all apples on 29 Nov.

yuki.status: {話したら|はなしたら}スッキリ…でも{月曜|げつよう}{憂鬱|ゆううつ}

log.summary: Monday 30 Nov: アルちゃん goes to 長野市 by train to buy gloves and goggles for the ski day. Scared of the snowy roads, he takes a taxi to a sports shop only five minutes' walk from the station; on the train home he thinks of レン but doesn't have the courage to message him.
new_facts: アルちゃん bought ski gloves and goggles in 長野市 on Mon 30 Nov.
On 30 Nov アルちゃん was in 長野市 but didn't tell レン; they still haven't met.
Snowy roads still scare アルちゃん.

log.summary: Tuesday 1 Dec, quiet evening at ゲストハウス風: 健太 catches アルちゃん grinning at his phone, and アルちゃん tells him for the first time about レン, a man he met on the app. 健太 is completely relaxed about it, teases him ('as a friend, or as a possible boyfriend?') and tells him to ask レン out for coffee.
new_facts: On 1 Dec アルちゃん came out to 健太 by telling him about レン; 健太 was relaxed and supportive.
健太 knows レン is a designer in 長野市 and that アルちゃん and レン haven't met yet.
アルちゃん admitted to 健太 that he'd like to meet レン; 健太 suggested inviting him for coffee.

kenta.status: {応援|おうえん}してるで☕ 12/10は{白馬|はくば}や🏂

log.summary: Wednesday 2 Dec: 恵子さん gets a photo from 由美 of 颯太's social-studies essay about 田中さん's childhood (deep snow up to the roof, no heating, five siblings under one kotatsu, skiing with his father) and reads it with アルちゃん at the kotatsu while 田中さん pretends not to listen. 颯太 writes he wants to be a footballer but one day take over the orchard.
new_facts: 田中さん grew up with four siblings (five children) in a house with no heating except a kotatsu.
田中さん's father used to take him skiing on snowy days.
颯太's essay 「おじいちゃんの子どもの頃」 got a 花丸 from his teacher; he will show it to 田中さん on Saturday 5 Dec.

log.summary: Thursday 3 Dec: taking 健太's advice, アルちゃん asks レン on LINE to meet for coffee in 長野市 on Sunday. レン compares a chain café by the station with an old 喫茶店 near his cinema whose owner roasts his own beans; they choose the 喫茶店 and fix 2 p.m.
new_facts: アルちゃん and レン will meet for the first time on Sunday 6 Dec at 14:00 in 長野市, at an old 喫茶店 near レン's favourite cinema; アルちゃん will message him when he gets off the train.
The 喫茶店 near the cinema is a bit pricier than the station chain café; its マスター roasts his own beans (自家焙煎).
The shopping-street supermarket closes at 8 p.m.; boxed meals and side dishes go half price before closing.

ren.status: {日曜|にちよう}、{楽しみ|たのしみ}☕

log.summary: Friday 4 Dec, after school at 鷹ノ原高校: 佐藤先生 asks アルちゃん in to help 澪 prepare for the selection interview for the school's summer exchange to Canada. アルちゃん says he's all for studying abroad; 澪 is sure her parents will say no because of the cost, 佐藤先生 mentions scholarships, and 澪 decides to talk to her parents that night.
new_facts: 鷹ノ原高校 has a summer exchange programme to Canada with a selection interview; 澪 is applying.
澪's school interview for the exchange is on Friday 11 Dec after school; アルちゃん promised to help her practise.
澪 thinks her parents will oppose studying abroad because of the cost; she planned to talk to them on the night of 4 Dec.

mio.status: {面接|めんせつ}{練習|れんしゅう}ガチでやる🎺✈

log.summary: Saturday 5 Dec, monthly mock day: 颯太 arrives for the weekend with his essay and shows it to 田中さん, and 恵子さん makes her apple hot pot for dinner.
new_facts: 田中さん read 颯太's essay on 5 Dec; he said little but kept it on the living-room shelf.

log.guest: 古川さん (owner of the 喫茶店 near レン's cinema)

When the owner 古川さん asks if they're friends, レン quickly says yes, which makes アルちゃん a little sad though he understands; snow starts falling, レン takes out his film camera, and they promise to walk in the snowy mountains next time.
new_facts: アルちゃん and レン met in person for the first time on Sun 6 Dec 2026, at the 喫茶店 near レン's cinema in 長野市.
The 喫茶店's owner (マスター) is 古川さん (68).
レン is taller than he looks in his photos.
In public, レン introduced アルちゃん as a friend (友達); アルちゃん felt a bit sad but understood.
レン and アルちゃん promised to walk in the snowy mountains together next time; no date set yet.

ren.status: {雪|ゆき}の{日|ひ}の{一枚|いちまい}📷

log.summary: Monday 7 Dec: after a cold day clearing snow in the orchard, 田中さん takes アルちゃん to the town onsen 鷹ノ湯 for the first time, explains the bath rules in a few words and buys him a coffee milk. 恵子さん leaves a voicemail asking him to buy tofu for 湯豆腐.
new_facts: The town onsen is 鷹ノ湯 (たかのゆ), near the station; it smells of sulphur and has a fridge of glass-bottle coffee milk.
アルちゃん went to an onsen for the first time on 7 Dec, with 田中さん.
恵子さん calls 田中さん お父さん.
Dinner on 7 Dec was 湯豆腐.

log.summary: Tuesday 8 Dec: アルちゃん bought New Year postcards and asks 由紀 on LINE how to send 年賀状. She tells him to post by about the 25th and write at least a line by hand, and says asking レン for his address is too soon: a LINE あけおめ is enough.
new_facts: アルちゃん plans to send 年賀状 to the 田中s, 佐藤先生 and 健太, each with a handwritten line.
アルちゃん won't send レン a 年賀状 (he doesn't know his address); a LINE あけおめ instead.
由紀 goes home to her parents' (実家) from 30 Dec for New Year.

yuki.status: {年末|ねんまつ}は{実家|じっか}で{寝正月|ねしょうがつ}{予定|よてい}💤

log.summary: Wednesday 9 Dec: ハナおばあちゃん makes soba in the 田中 kitchen with 恵子さん. She tells アルちゃん Nagano is famous for soba because it grows on cold mountain land where rice won't, and in the Edo period rice went to the lord as tax (年貢); 恵子さん wonders if that's why 隼人さま loved soba.
new_facts: ハナおばあちゃん makes 十割そば by hand and brought buckwheat flour to the 田中 house on 9 Dec.
恵子さん wants ハナおばあちゃん's soba for 年越しそば on New Year's Eve.
恵子さん invited アルちゃん to try soba-making (そば打ち); he said he'd love to if he has time.

log.summary: Thursday 10 Dec, the 白馬 ski day: at 6 a.m. 健太 messages アルちゃん not to oversleep, says the forecast gives heavy snow in 白馬 from midday and 翔さん promises powder in the morning, and passes on 沙織's warning about breaking a wrist when falling. Then 健太 himself is ten minutes late after shovelling snow.
new_facts: On the 白馬 ski day (10 Dec) 健太 was about 10 minutes late to 鷹ノ原駅 because he was shovelling snow.
沙織 (a nurse) warned that putting your hand out when you fall on skis easily breaks your wrist.
On 10 Dec it snowed heavily in 白馬 from midday; the morning was powder snow.
アルちゃん fell about ten times on his first ski day; 健太 posted a photo of him face-first in the snow in 「白馬いこ」.

kenta.status: アルちゃん、{10回|じゅっかい}{転んだ|ころんだ}ｗ🏂

log.summary: Friday 11 Dec: on 恵子さん's advice アルちゃん sends his family in Spain a Christmas parcel by airmail from the 鷹ノ原 post office; it's over 2 kg, so he swaps a bottle of apple juice for a letter to his mother. In the afternoon 佐藤先生 leaves a voicemail: 澪's interview went off fine and she spoke calmly thanks to practising with him.
new_facts: On 11 Dec アルちゃん sent his family in Spain a Christmas parcel by airmail (about a week), with a letter to his mother.
The 鷹ノ原 post office has an international mail (国際郵便) window.
アルちゃん practised the interview with 澪 before Fri 11 Dec; the interview went smoothly. The result isn't known yet.
アルちゃん's December plan: 年賀状 next week, then the big year-end clean (大掃除).

mio.status: {面接|めんせつ}{終わった|おわった}〜！{結果|けっか}{待ち|まち}🙏

log.summary: Saturday 12 Dec: アルちゃん goes with 田中さん and 颯太 to the 公民館's year-end singing contest (年忘れのど自慢大会). The organiser asks him to sing; he modestly accepts and sings a Spanish song, with 颯太 cheering.
new_facts: The 鷹ノ原 公民館 holds a 年忘れのど自慢大会 every December; アルちゃん sang a Spanish song there on Sat 12 Dec.
田中さん told アルちゃん he doesn't need to sing enka; he never sings himself.

sota.status: アルちゃんの{歌|うた}、すげー{盛り上がった|もりあがった}！🎤

log.summary: Sunday 13 Dec: レン posts his developed film photos from the snowy day they met. His sister 葵 comments asking who he went with and he answers only '秘密'; in a voice message he tells アルちゃん it doesn't mean anything bad, and says he plans to tell 葵 properly.
new_facts: レン posts his film photos on Instagram; アルちゃん follows him and commented on 13 Dec.
レン's film from 6 Dec took a week to develop.
レン plans to tell 葵 about アルちゃん properly soon; アルちゃん told him there's no hurry and suggested a film again.

ren.status: {現像|げんぞう}、{待った|まった}{甲斐|かい}があった📷

log.guest: 藤原さん (retired teacher from 名古屋, ski trip)
log.summary: Monday 14 Dec: on reception, アルちゃん answers a guest, 藤原さん, on the guesthouse LINE: his train is stopped by snow and he'll arrive after 9 p.m. アルちゃん tells him the bath is open until 10 and that とり吉 is open until 11; 健太 phones to check and offers to do breakfast the next morning.
new_facts: ゲストハウス風 has a LINE account guests can message; the reception tablet shows it.
At ゲストハウス風 the bath can be used until 22:00 and the door curfew (門限) is 23:00.
とり吉 on the shopping street is open until 23:00.
藤原さん (62, retired teacher from 名古屋) arrived safely at 21:20 on 14 Dec for a ski trip.
健太 made breakfast at the guesthouse on the morning of 15 Dec so アルちゃん could sleep in.

log.summary: Tuesday 15 Dec: after 4th-period English on 'future jobs', 澪 tells 佐藤先生 she wants to be an interpreter but worries the pay isn't stable; アルちゃん describes his unpaid farm-and-reception life, and 佐藤先生 advises thinking about both what you love and what you're good at. 恵子さん picks him up by car in the snow.
new_facts: 澪 wants to become an interpreter (通訳).
On 15 Dec 恵子さん drove to 鷹ノ原高校 at 4:30 to pick アルちゃん up because of heavy snow.
The result of 澪's exchange interview still isn't known on 15 Dec.

log.summary: Wednesday 16 Dec: after her company 忘年会 (her 部長 sang karaoke forever), 由紀 compares Christmas and New Year in Spain and Japan with アルちゃん on LINE, then asks if he'll spend the 24th with レン. He hasn't asked him yet; 由紀 says they're close enough and レン will be glad.
new_facts: 由紀's company 忘年会 was on Wed 16 Dec, at an izakaya with all-you-can-drink.
As of 16 Dec アルちゃん has no plans with レン for Christmas Eve and hasn't dared to ask him.
In 鷹ノ原 there is no rubbish collection from 30 Dec to 3 Jan.

yuki.status: {忘年会|ぼうねんかい}、{部長|ぶちょう}のカラオケ{地獄|じごく}…🎤

log.summary: Thursday 17 Dec: アルちゃん dropped his wallet on the 商店街 in the morning and found it already handed in at the 交番 by 鷹ノ原駅; the man from the rice shop (米屋さん) had picked it up, nothing missing. In the afternoon ハナおばあちゃん says it has always been a town where lost things come back because everyone knows each other; アルちゃん thinks it's more that handing things in is simply normal.

The 商店街 has a rice shop (米屋); its owner found アルちゃん's wallet on 17 Dec.
アルちゃん's wallet had about 5,000 yen in it; everything came back.

He admits 恵子さん called him ずくなし the night before because he stayed in the kotatsu instead of helping shovel snow; 健太 explains it means lazy and invites him to shovel snow together the next morning.

健太's English is very weak.
健太 and アルちゃん plan to shovel snow together on the morning of Sat 19 Dec.

log.summary: Saturday 19 Dec: after shovelling snow with 健太 in the morning, アルちゃん plucks up the courage on his break and asks レン to see a film together on the 24th. レン replies around 5 p.m. that his cinema is showing 『素晴らしき哉、人生！』 (It's a Wonderful Life), and leaves a voicemail: they'll meet in front of the cinema at 17:30.
new_facts: アルちゃん keeps a paper diary.
アルちゃん asked レン out himself on 19 Dec.
Date set: Thu 24 Dec, meet in front of レン's cinema in 長野市 at 17:30; 『素晴らしき哉、人生！』 screens at 18:00.
アルちゃん's lower back hurt after shovelling snow on 19 Dec.

ren.status: 24{日|か}の{上映|じょうえい}、{楽しみ|たのしみ}🎞

log.summary: Sunday 20 Dec: 恵子さん and 田中さん are in 長野市 buying お歳暮 at the last minute, so アルちゃん and 颯太 make lunch, following 恵子さん's tips on the family LINE. アルちゃん says he's never made yakisoba but is good at paella; 恵子さん asks him to make it for dinner and buys prawns and squid on the way back. The yakisoba burns because 颯太 won't stop stirring; 颯太 says the burnt bits are the best.

恵子さん bought the family's お歳暮 at a department store in 長野市 on 20 Dec.
アルちゃん has never made yakisoba; the yakisoba lunch on 20 Dec got burnt.

log.summary: Monday 21 Dec: after a video call with his mother, アルちゃん feels homesick: it's his first Christmas away from his family. 田中さん, who liked his paella, tells him it's when you're lonely that you should move your body, asks him to help knock snow off the apple branches the next morning, and says that being apart is what makes you value family, and that this is his home too.
new_facts: アルちゃん video-called his mother on 21 Dec; 2026 is his first Christmas away from his family.
田中さん liked アルちゃん's paella.
On the morning of Tue 22 Dec アルちゃん helps 田中さん knock snow off the apple branches (from 5 a.m.).

log.guest: 小池さん (鷹ノ原's taxi driver)
log.summary: Tuesday 22 Dec, the winter solstice: snow and wind cancel the 4 o'clock bus from 鷹ノ原高校, so アルちゃん books 小池さん, the town's only taxi driver, on LINE. Stuck in a jam on the main road, she picks him up about 20 minutes later and tells him to take a ゆず湯 tonight so he doesn't catch a cold.
new_facts: 小池さん (小池和子, 66) is 鷹ノ原's only taxi driver; she takes bookings on LINE and calls 恵子さん 恵子ちゃん (they were classmates).
恵子さん gave アルちゃん 小池さん's LINE for days when the bus doesn't run.
On 22 Dec (冬至) the 4 p.m. bus from 鷹ノ原高校 was cancelled (運休) because of snow; the main road (国道) was jammed.
The 田中 house has pumpkin and a ゆず湯 for 冬至.

log.summary: Wednesday 23 Dec: 恵子さん told ハナおばあちゃん that アルちゃん is going to 長野 on Christmas Eve, and by lunch the whole town, guesthouse included, has heard he has a 'girlfriend' there. アルちゃん doesn't want to hide it but couldn't deny it; only 健太 knows the truth. He finally understands what レン meant about gossip in small towns.
new_facts: By 23 Dec a rumour has spread round 鷹ノ原 that アルちゃん has a girlfriend in 長野; he didn't correct it.
恵子さん has heard about the 'date' but not that it's with a man; she will drive アルちゃん to 鷹ノ原駅 on 24 Dec, leaving the house at 4 p.m.
The 田中s pass a 回覧板 (neighbourhood circular) to ハナおばあちゃん's house.

log.summary: Thursday 24 Dec, Christmas Eve: アルちゃん and レン's first real date, 『素晴らしき哉、人生！』 at レン's cinema; both cried at the ending. Walking to 長野駅 in the snow, they plan their next date: a snowshoe walk at 戸隠 on 3 January, meeting at 長野駅 at 9 a.m.
new_facts: アルちゃん and レン had their first real date on 24 Dec 2026 (film at レン's cinema in 長野市).
レン has seen 『素晴らしき哉、人生！』 many times and cries every time.
Next date: Sun 3 Jan 2027, snowshoe walk at 戸隠; meet at 長野駅 at 9:00.
On the evening of 24 Dec, trains from 長野 towards 鷹ノ原 were about 15 minutes late because of snow.
Before New Year アルちゃん helps the 田中s with the 大掃除 and with soba-making (そば打ち).

ren.status: {久しぶり|ひさしぶり}に{泣けた|なけた}イブ🎞❄

log.summary: Friday 25 Dec, Christmas Day (an ordinary workday in Japan) and the last day to post 年賀状 for New Year's Day: アルちゃん writes his card to the 田中 family, thanking them in keigo, with handwritten lines for 田中さん, 恵子さん and 颯太, and posts it.
new_facts: アルちゃん posted his 年賀状 on 25 Dec, so they arrive on 1 Jan; the 田中 family's card has handwritten lines for 田中さん (to help more with snow and pruning), 恵子さん (he's put on weight from her cooking) and 颯太 (build a snowman together).
アルちゃん promised 颯太 to build a snowman together during the winter break.

log.summary: Saturday 26 Dec: 颯太 is on winter break at the farm. He and アルちゃん do 恵子さん's New Year shopping at the packed 商店街 supermarket (red-and-white kamaboko at twice the usual price), while アルちゃん tells 由紀 on LINE that Christmas Eve was the best: they both cried at the film, and the next date is 戸隠 on 3 Jan. 由紀 tells him to buy 颯太 some sweets.
new_facts: 颯太 is staying at the 田中 farm for the winter break from 26 Dec.
On 26 Dec the 商店街 supermarket was packed with New Year shoppers; the checkout queue was about 30 minutes.
由紀 knows about the 24 Dec date and the 3 Jan 戸隠 plan.

log.summary: Sunday 27 Dec: at the 鷹ノ原高校 brass band's year-end concert in the 公民館, 澪 tells アルちゃん she passed the exchange interview and asks him to film her solo, because her hands shake every time she plays on stage. 颯太 begs to try her trumpet afterwards.
new_facts: The 鷹ノ原高校 brass band (吹奏楽部) gave a free year-end concert at the 公民館 on Sun 27 Dec 2026.
澪 passed the selection interview for the summer exchange to Canada.
澪 had a trumpet solo at the concert; her hands shake every time she plays for real. アルちゃん filmed the solo for her.
颯太 asked to try 澪's trumpet after the concert.
On 27 Dec 恵子さん asked アルちゃん to buy two bags of rice cakes (お餅) on the shopping street on the way home.

log.summary: Monday 28 Dec, 仕事納め: after heavy overnight snow, 健太 tells アルちゃん on LINE that snow fell on his head the moment he opened the guesthouse door. In the white orchard アルちゃん finds a line of small footprints and sees a fluffy tail: a fox, but it runs off the moment he tries to photograph it.
new_facts: Foxes (キツネ) come down from the mountains to the 田中 orchard in winter; 田中さん told 健太 so.
On the morning of 28 Dec 2026 アルちゃん saw a fox in the orchard but couldn't photograph it.
アルちゃん wears glasses (they fog up in the cold).
鷹ノ原 town hall (役場) closed for the year on 28 Dec and reopens on Mon 4 Jan 2027; it makes announcements on the 防災無線.
There is a yellow 凍結注意 sign on the farm road outside the 田中 house.
